clearSpace.$description: Clear space around a logo, as a share of the logo's height, on every side (ADR-0016, REQ-030 AC3).

icon.$description: Minimum height of the icon logo, chosen by the owner (ADR-0016).

vertical.$description: Minimum height of the vertical lockup, chosen by the owner (ADR-0016).

horizontal.$description: Minimum height of the horizontal wordmark, chosen by the owner (ADR-0016).
